sn22.91:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pa || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rāhulo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.91:1.3: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṃkāra-mamaṃkāramānānusayā na hontīti || || 4
sn22.91:2.1: Yaṃ kiñci Rāhula rūpam atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattam vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā || yaṃ dūre santike vā sabbaṃ rūpaṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati || 5-7
sn22.91:2.5: Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇam atītānāgatapaccuppannam ajjhattaṃ va bahiddhā va || pa || ||
sn22.91:2.6: Sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ netam mama Neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati || || 9
sn22.91:2.7: Evaṃ kho Rāhula jānato evam passato imasmiṃ ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṃkāramamaṃkāra-mānānusayā na hontīti || || 1-2
